description_en: Submits a digital watermarking (copyright watermark or tracing watermark) extraction job to asynchronously extract a copyright watermark or tracing watermark
description_zh: 通过调用本接口提交数字水印（版权水印或溯源水印）提取作业，开始异步提取版权水印或溯源水印
name: SubmitDigitalWatermarkExtractJob

parameters.help_en:
The video ID of the video from which you want to extract the watermark. Only a single video ID is supported. You can obtain the video ID by using the following methods:
Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the video ID.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436559.html operation. The video ID (VideoId) is returned in the response
parameters.help_zh:
待提取水印的视频的视频ID，仅支持传入单个视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
登录视频点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436559.html接口请求后会返回视频ID（VideoId）
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of watermark extraction. Valid values:

TraceMark: tracing watermark.
CopyrightMark: copyright watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印提取类型。取值：

TraceMark：溯源水印。
CopyrightMark：版权水印
parameters.name: extract_type

JobId.description_en: The ID of the watermark extraction job. This ID can be used as a request parameter of the [GetDigitalWatermarkExtractResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587769.html） operation
JobId.description_zh: 水印提取作业ID。可作为[GetDigitalWatermarkExtractResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587769.html）接口的请求参数
